subject: Pilot timeline impacted by connector issue — request for trial extension
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@lumenpath.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Ramos <diego.r@lumenpath.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Pilot timeline impacted by connector issue — request for trial extension

Hi Priyom,

Hope you’re well. Quick update from our side: our integration team hit an unexpected blocker with the third-party data connector (vendor pushed a minor API change over the weekend that breaks the batch ingestion). The engineering team estimates ~2–3 weeks to remediate and re-run end-to-end tests.

Given the delay, we’re worried about losing momentum on the pilot and the internal exec window. Would Redwood be able to extend the trial window by 30 days and provide a small sandbox/top-up of credits so our engineers can finish verification without throttling?

I attached the integration log excerpt that shows the errors we’re seeing (integration-log.txt).

We’ve been really happy with the early throughput and cost numbers — want to keep the pilot moving. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the errors if helpful.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Product
LumenPath

---
Attachment: integration-log.txt (text/plain, 34KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@lumenpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 18:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline impacted by connector issue — request for trial extension

Thanks for the note, Elena — sorry to hear about the vendor change, that’s frustrating. Appreciate the log; Diego’s timeline sounds reasonable.

We can absolutely help keep the pilot on track. Proposed quick path:
- 30 calendar day extension to your sandbox/pilot window
- 50k token sandbox/top-up (to cover re-tests and additional evals)
- Priority support from our integrations squad for two sync calls during the remediation window

Marissa / Ben — can you confirm internal sign-off on the credit top-up and any billing implications so I can confirm to Elena? I’ll hold off on formalizing until we have that OK.

Elena — if that works I’ll send a short amendment and a DocuSign link for the extension. Also happy to do a 30-min tech sync with your eng lead.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0173

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline impacted by connector issue — request for trial extension

Looping in Ben for ops/approval. A few notes from my side:

- I support the 30-day extension and 50k token top-up as an exception to keep the deal momentum — LumenPath has a solid evaluation trajectory and the exec window is narrow.
- We should tie the extension to a simple amendment (one-paragraph extension + new expiry + credit amount) rather than issuing a new promo code. Keeps finance happy. I’ve attached a draft SOW amendment for the legal/finance redline (SOW-draft.pdf).
- Ben, can you confirm whether the top-up needs PR approval or can be granted via Sales Ops allowance? If PR needed, what is expected lead time?

If Ops gives green light I’ll approve and Priyom can send the DocuSign. Also recommend scheduling a technical sync between Redwood integration eng and LumenPath’s Diego — I can coordinate calendars.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: SOW-draft.pdf (application/pdf, 18KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@lumenpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 11:06:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline impacted by connector issue — request for trial extension

Elena — great news: we’ve approved the request. Summary of what Redwood will provide:

- 30 calendar day extension to your current pilot (new expiry: 2026-11-03).
- 50,000 token sandbox/top-up applied to your pilot environment (visible in console within 24 hours).
- Two scheduled integration office hours with our integrations squad (please propose 2x 60-min slots).
- A one-paragraph amendment (sent via DocuSign) that extends the pilot and documents the top-up — no change to pricing or core terms.

I’ve asked Legal/Sales Ops to push the DocuSign link; you should get it shortly. Ben/Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround.

Elena, please confirm the proposed dates for the tech sync or share availability for Diego and your eng lead. We’ll also follow up with a short checklist to help speed verification once the vendor fix is deployed.

Appreciate the heads-up and glad we can help keep things moving.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0173
